correctness.rationale: Franklin graph is the twelve-vertex [5,-5]^6 cubic graph with 18 edges. The total 4-cut face predicate is: complement contains an independent 4-set. Fresh independent enumeration finds exactly 45 independent 4-sets and 2,533 augmented faces with f-vector (1,12,66,220,495,792,638,264,45). The record greedy vertex order yields 1,245 matched face pairs and 43 unmatched 4-dimensional faces, and a complete directed Hasse topological sort verifies acyclicity; after empty-face removal Forman gives a wedge of 43 S4. Independently enumerated all 48 graph automorphisms and signed invariant-face Lefschetz sums, reproducing the rational character trace multiset (43:1,5:3,-1:9,-7:6,-5:6,1:23) and zero invariant rank. Purity dimension 7 with H4 !=0 precludes pure shellability.
residual_risks: Character is rational only, not integral equivariant splitting; single named graph and k=4.

value.rationale: The Franklin graph is a standard symmetric cubic graph and total four-cut complexes are a natural member of the graph-cut filtration. The exact integral homotopy 43 S4, strict non-shellability in a pure 7-dimensional complex, and full 48-element rational symmetry character provide precise, nontrivial invariants of a canonical finite object that are not mechanically implied by prior k=2 or nearby-graph calculations. Such exact equivariant data are independently useful without an infinite graph-family theorem.
residual_risks: Scope is one graph and parameter; no all-cubic classification or integral representation claim.

limitations: Only standard Franklin [5,-5]^6 graph and four-cut complex; no integer equivariant module decomposition.
